newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KNP BT sees better ordinary profit in 1997.
newsitem.headline: KNP BT sees better ordinary profit in 1997.

text.p: Dutch paper group KNP BT said on Wednesday it expected a significant improvement in its earnings from ordinary operations in 1997.

"The various measures that have been taken and that are being developed respectively, are to lead to a structural improvement of profitability, and will already in 1997 contribute to a material improvement of the result on ordinary operations," KNP BT said in a statement.
KNP BT said the state of the paper market continued to have major repercussions on its results.
"In the fourth quarter of 1996 paper prices showed only a slight rise despite healthy demand. It is not clear whether this recovery will continue in 1997," it said.
KNP BT said that as long as the paper market did not deteriorate it expected operational results in 1997 of its majority owned KNP Leykam paper unit to recover.

"We take a positive view with regard to prospects for KNP BT Distribution and KNP BT Packaging. Both sectors offer good potential for further growth in their core activities and an attractive return," the company said.
